profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
Hi there! I'm a software engineer at Google who is passionate about technology! I have 6.5+ years of experience specializing in backend development, cloud infrastructure, and data analysis.

Most recently, I've been designing and developing backend microservices and high throughput ingestion pipelines in Golang. These provide Verily digital pathology and biomarker analysis capabilities, in service of next-generation clinical trials and treatments.

I've had extensive experience from soup-to-nuts in software development lifecycles, from scoping discussions and system requirements to design, implementation, integration/load testing, and monitoring.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked on Surgical Insights Platform, writing backend cloud infrastructure in Golang to interface with real-time ML systems providing computer-assisted analytics to surgeons in the operating room, boosting polyp detection rate for colonoscopies by 30%.
* Led design and implementation of ingestion pipeline to traceably and efficiently store ML inference results from processed operation videos using Temporal. Also led design and implementation of Surgical Insights Analytics Service, to make ingested results available for filtering, aggregation and statistical operations using ElasticSearch. This enabled a successful pilot of these procedure insights features with Duke University, enabling a surgical department to use the platform.
* Iterated and improved user experience for surgeons sharing surgical case videos. Implemented backend changes using Golang in our proprietary server framework and integrated WebSockets, RXJS, and Angular on frontend using Typescript. Collaborated closely with UX team to ensure alignment with user needs.
* Designed distributed system using Golang, Cloud Workflows, GCS, Spanner and BigQuery to ingest, analyze and visualize Verily hardware manufacturing logs, enabling external manufacturing. Reduces time-to-ingestion from an hour to < 5 seconds, facilitating
real-time debugging for engineers and contractors.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and implemented parts of scalable API integration testing coverage metrics pipeline, enabling data-driven decision-making across Google projects for software reliability investments. Resulted in ability to prioritize high QPS but low test coverage services at YouTube for enhanced reliability.
* Contributed heavily to YouTube Developer Environment efforts, allowing developers to spin up prod-like environments at their current commit. Overcame technical challenges related to traffic sampling, server optimization, and service dependency imputation, resulting in local YouTube environment setup time reduction from >45 minutes to under 5 minutes.
* Mentored for Python readability initiative across Google, reviewing and enhancing code quality of 500+ engineers, resulting in higher code quality and improved developer velocity across the company.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Investigated the 18S loop of eukaryotic ribosomes, and work in Python, MS SQL and Aqua Data Studio to generate and visualize mRNA and protein sequences.

Analyzed the periodicity of mRNA codon windows, as well as slip sites within the mRNA transcriptome, in order to relate the Kozak consensus and the periodicity of mRNA bases to the relative translation rates of different hypothetical protein.

positions.title: Organizer, Wesleyan Hackathon Club
positions.description:
Organized and coordinated with Wesleyan University departments and funding opportunities to facilitate easier access to hackathons and technical and engineering opportunities to Wesleyan students. Developed a focus on accessibility in tech, in order to counteract the social and economic forces that tend to discourage some people, particularly women and minorities, from taking part.

Mentored beginner programmers and directed them to resources for them to develop their skills, and communicated with the Computer Science department to make these resources accessible to everyone.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Used my experience with Python and SQL databases to assist in BIOL265 (Bioinformatics Programming).

Assisted students by providing them feedback on their program designs, and graded coursework in Python with SQL queries.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Science, Molecular Biology and Biochemistry, Data Science
